en.help_tooltip:
The Clan will catch some amount of prey over each timeskip, but successful hunting patrols are the most important source of freshkill. Freshkill can't be stored endlessly: after four moons prey will rot and will be thrown away. Cats under 3 moons with a parent (queen) taking care of them won't need food. Cat will only display here if their hunger status is less than stuffed!

Ranks are fed in the following order, from lowest to highest. Each rank lists how much prey they will need for a moon.
